name: 55386 · Victoria, MN
findings: ZIP 55386 (Victoria) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55386 (Victoria) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 55386 (Victoria) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
